en.title: Turn the Page and We're Above the Clouds! ~The Flying Used Bookstore and a Hungry Love Story~
en.premise: While tending the counter at a second-hand bookstore, I meet Haru, an utterly clumsy boy searching for "the most delicious bread recipe book in the world." To help him find it, I take him on a journey through the skies aboard the shop's small flying ship! Eating delicious food, laughing, and somehow finding my heart racing for him—a mouthwatering coming-of-age romance story.

zh.title: 翻开书页便在云端之上！～会飞的旧书店与空腹少年的恋爱物语～
zh.premise: 看守旧书店的我，有一天遇见了正在寻找“世界上最美味的面包食谱书”、笨拙得无以复加的少年——哈鲁。为了帮他寻找这本书，我带着他坐上店里的小型飞船，开启了一场云端之旅！品尝美食、欢笑，不知不觉间为他心动不已，这是一部充满美味气息的青春恋爱物语。
